Designed for the elite, the trendsetter, and the collector of moments, this timepiece doesn't just tell time, it narrates your legacy. Unrivaled Features for the Discerning Explorer Premium Specs: Featuring a premium Seiko automatic movement, encased in robust titanium, and the assurance of a 1250m water resistance, this watch is built for both the boardroom and the abyss. Superior Luminosity: Outshine the depths with premium Grade A BWG9 Swiss Super Luminova that glows 70% brighter and lasts significantly longer than standard offerings. Exclusive Craftsmanship: Meticulously handcrafted, blending 250-year-old technology with modern precision, and featuring a sapphire crystal that is nearly scratchproof. Incomparable Design: A 42mm titanium case with a stunning blue dial and bi-directional rotating ceramic bezel ensures functionality and elegance at every glance. A Testimony to Quality "This watch is beautiful! It exceeded my expectations in appearance and function. I am a big admirer of GMT watches owning a Rolex GMT 2, called the Root Beer model. But it is not practical to wear every day. However, the Oceaneva works great as an everyday watch. I get multiple comments on it. I love to tell those who ask what it is and explain how well it is made. The lume is very good. ." - A Satisfied Customer*** Echoing the Voice of Our Community "This watch is beautiful! It exceeded my expectations in appearance and function." - shares a satisfied customer, highlighting not just the watch's aesthetic appeal but its versatile functionality as an everyday luxury. Exclusive Invitation for the Visionaries and Pioneers The Oceaneva™ Men's GMT Automatic Deep Marine Explorer is not just a purchase; it's an investment in distinction, a companion for your milestones, and potentially, the heirloom of your legacy. What story will your Oceaneva tell? Unveil the essence of exploration, luxury, and unparalleled craftsmanship. Embark on your next adventure, define success on your terms, and immortalize your moments with Oceaneva™. Experience the ultimate in luxury timekeeping. Your legacy awaits. *** We are not affiliated with Rolex. Trademarks are property of their respective owners. watches.description: Introducing the pinnacle of deep-sea exploration watches - the Oceaneva™ Men's GMT TITANIUM Automatic Deep Marine Explorer 1250M. It's a treasure of wealth, a beacon of success, and a herald of adventures to come. Imagine the stories you will tell with Oceaneva on your wrist. Seize the moment to redefine luxury and adventure. The ocean depths await, and time is of the essence. Capture the essence of exploration and success today and become part of an exclusive circle of adventurers. Your story is unique. Your watch should be, too. Step into a world where luxury meets adventure. Discover your Oceaneva. *** We are not affiliated with Rolex. Trademarks are property of their respective owners. Skillfully constructed from 304 and 316L stainless steel to create premium Damascus steel, the watch combines strength and artistry. Its captivating black enamel dial is paired with a robust FKM black rubber strap and a Damascus steel buckle, offering an unbeatable pairing of style and resilience. Finished with a nearly scratch-resistant, anti-reflective domed sapphire crystal and a Damascus steel unidirectional bezel, it’s created for individuals who demand excellence in every aspect of their lives. Designed for the discerning luxury watch enthusiast, adventurous spirit, and dedicated diver, these timepieces are a perfect blend of style, precision, and durability. Key Features High-Quality Italian Leather Strap Experience the ultimate in comfort and sophistication with our high-quality Italian leather straps. Embossed with a chic crocodile pattern and available in elegant blue, these straps add a touch of class to any outfit. 316L Stainless Steel Case and Buckle Crafted from premium 316L stainless steel, the case and buckle offer unmatched durability and elegance. The brushed case sides, polished bezel, and lugs ensure your watch remains pristine through all your adventures. 200m Water Resistance With a water resistance of up to 200 meters (656 feet), the OceanTrek GMT easily transitions from a stylish dress watch to an essential diver's companion. Just swap the leather strap for a rubber one to suit your aquatic activities. Screw-Down Crown The screw-down crown, adorned with a trident logo, ensures your watch stays sealed and protected, even during demanding underwater expeditions. SEIKO NH34A GMT Automatic Movement Powered by the reliable SEIKO NH34A GMT automatic movement, this watch boasts a 41-hour power reserve, 24 jewels, and Seiko's proprietary Diashock system. Effortlessly track multiple time zones with its precise 4-hand movement. Luxury Dial The blue dial, crafted using a hydraulic press method, features intricate patterns and relief silver-tone Roman numerals, providing both elegance and readability. Anti-reflective sapphire crystal, nearly scratchproof and 2.95mm thick, protects the dial. High-Quality Fit and Finish Every component of the OceanTrek GMT is meticulously crafted to ensure a seamless and luxurious experience. The top-quality precision machining and Grade A fit and finish highlight our commitment to excellence. See-Through Caseback Admire the intricate mechanics of your timepiece through the see-through, screw-down caseback, sealed to meet the 200m water resistance standard.
